name: Mercuria
bio: Archetype: AFK Buff, High Tier Skill Synergy. ⌽ Gains [Cosmic Energy] whenever she or an ally uses a skill. Higher tier skills grant more stacks. ⌽ [Cosmic Energy] buffs team's damage. 9+ stacks grant Crit DMG buff, 16+ grants Incantation Might. ⌽ If multiple high-tier skills are used in one turn, gains 1 additional Moxie. ⌽ Ultimate: Dispels enemy buffs and grants the whole team [Rank Up]. This effect does not increase the effect or multipliers, but it does affect insights that rely on higher tier card or effects such as Vila's enhanced buff.
